InventoryCommand.description: Strict bounded command. Fields are interpreted by the selected operation; unknown fields are rejected.

info.description: Section 12B authoritative vendor-owned inventory, reservations, stock operations, preorder/backorder, variable fulfilment and effective discovery. Physical stock never becomes negative. Expired or quarantined lots are not sellable. Approximate calibration is never exact reservation arithmetic. No Customer PII, Order authority, Wallet/payment, logistics execution or KarryGo dark-store inventory is implemented.
info.title: KarryGo Vendor Service — Section 12B Shop Inventory
